_doc: Delo Derby v8 — the RUNNING POOL (2026-05-26). Operating model (Jason): the derby is the single GPU executor; it doles 300s (5-min) chunks by Δelo-rate (peak-progress + patience). The derby RUNNER (the orchestrating Claude session) keeps it stocked and swaps contestants in/out by judgement — a lane that plateaus or gets starved is swapped for a fresh cell from run_sweep.CELLS; a climber keeps getting fed. Everything gets run eventually, so no single pick is 'wrong'. Beads are NOT used to run the GPU — beads are CODE-only work for OTHER sessions that lands a new cell 'available for the derby'; the runner then swaps it in. cap_wall_secs is a generous backstop (4h), NOT a hard 1h kill — the ~hourly assessment + swap is the runner's job, so a climbing lane is never cut off. Current 4 contestants on the v5+v6 best base (vcf + global-pool): control (the bar), mate-discount (v6 H2H winner solo), stack (vcf+global-pool + value-discount + max-plies = combine the v6 winners, the 'best recipe' bet), buffer-comp (recency curator, the gated new lever). Swap-pool candidates already in CELLS: derby-v7-adjudicate, derby-x-stack. Verdict = head-to-head round-robin (scripts/round_robin.py) over peaks — anchored elo saturates ~1700.
